assets.name: おしゃべりラッパバード
assets.design: A comically noisy yellow trumpet-bird: a wide brass trumpet bell forms its beak, feathered cheek tufts, two enormous inflated cheeks, short fat belly and broad wings held as a conductor. It is completely absorbed in its terrible performance. Eyes are two fully closed joyful upward crescents, NO open golden slit eyes. One raised foot stepping to its own beat. Broad flared silhouette. Punchy premium comic illustration: crisp dark navy ink, bold shaped shadows, bright yellow/brass/turquoise, energetic graphic shapes. Not the warm densely painted style of every other creature. Rich intentional material highlights, visually sophisticated, not a generic vector icon.

assets.name: つまみぐいスナックオーク
assets.design: A hilariously guilty small orange peach-skinned snack orc. Very pear-shaped plump body, tiny head, short feet, huge drooping ears, little harmless lower tusks, oversized apron and empty cookie jar held behind its back; one cookie cheek-bulge and visible crumbs. Big pale oval eyes stare nervously sideways, raised apologetic eyebrows, tiny embarrassed crooked mouth. It has obviously eaten all the snacks. No angry brows, no half-lidded yellow stare. Cute funny opponent, no weapons. Premium children's-storybook gouache illustration. Soft warm matt surfaces, beautifully modeled volume, subtle brush grain INSIDE the character, gentle ink contours, warm orange/cream with a small mint accent. Clear broad shapes and expressive body language; polished fantasy-game asset rather than flat icon or photorealism.

assets.name: らくがきスターゴースト
assets.design: A mischievous pink star-shaped doodle ghost drawn into life. Its entire asymmetric five-point star body is made of stacked torn pink paper and thick scribbled wax-crayon marks; two tiny mitten arms holding one chunky purple crayon, folded pointed tail. Eye design: two unequal black dot eyes on cream paper patches, NO visible irises, NO narrowed eyelids. Big open triangular laughing mouth. Proudly displaying its own paper-star body, very playful. All markings are abstract scribbles, not letters. High-quality handcrafted paper-collage and wax-crayon children's fantasy illustration, bold navy hand-ink edge, intentional irregular paper layers, matte tactile textures, striking flat-to-shallow-depth silhouette. Maintain production polish and excellent readability, not an unfinished child's drawing; no glossy painted metallic shading.

assets.name: まいごの消しゴムナイト
assets.design: A lost eraser knight: the large vertical rounded ivory rubber eraser is the actual torso/head, wearing a small blue silver knight helmet tipped crooked, a red pencil-eraser cap like a tiny plume, paper-label belt with NO words, stubby boots. Holding a small wooden ruler as a sword and a pencil-case lid shield. Helmet visor lifted so two HUGE round pale blue eyes and tiny black pupils looking in opposite directions are visible. Soft anxious eyebrows and small worried wavy mouth. Awkwardly turned inward knees, earnest cute lost little hero-opponent, not angry or menacing. Premium stylized clay-and-rubber toy fantasy render translated into a game illustration. Matte rounded eraser texture, soft sculpted edges, restrained blue metallic armor, clear dark edge definition, little warm cel-shaded light. Visibly different tactile art from comic ink, gouache and paper collage. Not photorealism, not glossy plastic, no surrounding scene.

assets.name: そうじサボりダストマスク
assets.design: A lazy dust-mask ghost, an enormously fluffy oval gray dust bunny with an oversized crooked pale cleaning mask built into its face, loose rag-like ears, two thin noodly arms and tiny dragging slippers. Two gentle drooping BLACK oval eye holes in the pale mask, one eyebrow nearly falling asleep, NO gold irises or sinister slits. A little dusty moustache and tiny yawn visible under the mask. Holding an abandoned small dustpan upside down as a hat. Comically exhausted by the thought of cleaning. Entire fluff has clean contained silhouette, no floating dust particles. Elegant humorous ink-and-soft-watercolor fantasy character, charcoal gray plush tufts and misty lavender shading, warm pale mask, mostly muted limited palette with a tiny muted coral accent. More ragged and airy than the toy or bright comic characters, detailed intentional feathered internal texture, strong readable edge, charming studio-quality illustration.
